Theme

Body, health & movement

feel cold verb

also feeling cold, be cold, coldness, the cold, get cold, catch cold, liable to get cold, sensitive to the cold, my hands are cold, my feet are cold

algeō, algēre, alsī

verb, second conjugation

Other words

  • frīgeō, frīgēre — be cold

    verb, second conjugation · also used · classical · Traupman 293

  • frīgus, frīgoris n. — coldness

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 135; Traupman 293

    Not normally the illness.

  • algēscō, algēscere, alsī — catch cold, get cold

    verb, third conjugation · also used · classical · Ter. Ad. 1.1.11: nē ille alserit (Lewis & Short); Traupman 135; Traupman 293

  • alsiōsus, alsiōsa, alsiōsum — sensitive to cold, easily chilled

    declension · also used · classical · Varr. RR 2.3.6; Plin. NH 21.60 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 135; Traupman 293

Examples

  • Nihil jam frīgidī.

    Nothing cold now.composed

  • Manūs pedēsque frīgent.

    My hands and feet are cold.Traupman 293

See also cold.
